final_netlist:
.subckt dut vin vout vref vss ibias
* ---- bias: IREF (from vin into ibias) -> NMOS diode, mirrored to tail ----
MB0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
MT  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=8 L=1
* ---- error amp: NMOS pair (fb on diode side, vref on output side) ----
M1  d1   fb   tail vss nfet W=20 L=1
M2  gate vref tail vss nfet W=20 L=1
M3  d1   d1   vin  vin pfet W=4 L=1
M4  gate d1   vin  vin pfet W=4 L=1
* ---- PMOS pass device ----
MP  vout gate vin vin pfet W=150 L=0.15 m=10
* ---- feedback divider (Vout = 2*Vref) with feed-forward cap ----
RF1 vout fb 200000
RF2 fb   vss 200000
CFF vout fb 2e-12
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----
CC  gate cz 5e-12
RZ  cz   vout 5000
.ends
